command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
p='split_lines.sh'
s=open(p).read()
bad="IFS=$
\n'
read -r -a parts <<< "$1"
for p in "${parts[@]}"; do
  echo "[$p]"
done"
good="IFS=$'\n'
read -r -a parts <<< "$1"
for p in "${parts[@]}"; do
  echo "[$p]"
done"
assert bad in s, "pattern not found"
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(bad,good))
PY
cat -A split_lines.sh
